entry_target: >=10% observed gain before a -10% adverse move, within 24h; exact complete future required for labels only. No 95%-of-best restriction.
exit_target: EXIT iff the current executable price is at least as good as every strictly later executable price before this entry's original 24h deadline; otherwise HOLD. Both directions use the same side-adjusted rule.
quality: Missing mandatory input prevents entry; missing mandatory exit state requests an exit at the next execution attempt. Optional columns below 80% training coverage are dropped. Remaining optional values receive training-only medians and explicit missing indicators.
selection: Fixed 4000 updates. Entry scores mapped to training-reference percentiles; no probability claim. Average three seeds. Choose from 9 thresholds only if all seed validation PnLs are positive, at least two thirds of traded days are positive, at least 3 days/5 symbols/20 trades, and a day-block bootstrap lower bound exceeds cash. Lower bound uses 0.05/9 tail probability. This is a conservative selection heuristic, not a generalization guarantee.
splits: Earlier frozen folds, 24h purge. Actual archive ends are fixed before replay. Test candidate admission never uses future returns, future gaps, target labels or maturity. Reused test periods are model-unseen but research-examined.
comparison: Frozen baseline replays with corrected archive ends, baseline with same causal entry quality gate, repaired individual seed policies with old single-window selector, and repaired three-seed ensemble with robust selector.
publication: Historical sources lack receipt/revision timestamps; event-time research only. Runtime policy defaults to abstaining unless availability is verified. No retrospective publication times are invented.
